title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1969-05-03
lineage: PCM (Sony SL-HF66) > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramtch Pro >Tascam DA-3000 (16-bit/44.1k) > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/16
source: (Stage) Sony Stereo Mic > Master Reel > PCM

ai_review.summary: Excellent recording with a powerful Other One jam, featuring a clear mix and high‑energy performance.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the sweet, well‑balanced sound – noting more tom (TC) in the mix and fewer vocals – and celebrate the incendiary Other One jams that showcase the band's relentless energy. The show is described as full of single‑note runs and unstoppable rhythm, making it a standout performance despite the lack of detailed set‑list commentary.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 5‑star reviews praise both the recording clarity and the energetic Other One performance, indicating an outstanding show with excellent sound quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a 'sweet' recording with more tom (TC) in the mix and reduced vocals, suggesting a clear, well‑balanced audio capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy performance highlighted by strong band cohesion, especially during the extended Other One jams.
